maya: Evening transfer — quick pass for the team. I'm primary until 22:00 UTC. Summary: KV-cache spike at ~18:10 UTC caused p95 token latencies to rise to ~1.8s for eu-west. Autoscaler kicked but a brief bounce produced transient 503s. PagerDuty paged on customer-facing 503s; regional fallback engaged automatically. No ongoing pages at the moment.

ops-bot: Incident digest — 3 alerts (18:09–18:45 UTC). 2 pagerduty pages, both acknowledged and resolved. Runbooks referenced: /runbooks/kv-eviction, /runbooks/regional-fallback. Links: https://dash.ops/incidents/1809999999

elliot: Thanks. Quick Qs — current customer impact? any open support tickets or data loss concerns?

oliver (sre-lead): One customer (acme-corp) reported degraded responses from 18:12–18:40 UTC. Support ticket #12345 created and linked to the incident. No evidence of data exfiltration. Runbook steps followed: removed pressure by throttling low-priority tenants, kicked off cache-regen job.

maya: Current status: system stable. Autoscaler set to conservative for next 2 hours to avoid thrash, cache-regen job at step 3/4. Watching metric `kvcache.evictions` and `p95.token_latency.eu-west`. TL;DR: no rollback required.

pagerduty: PagerLog => page_id=PD-1809-01, severity=3, assigned=elliot, ack=18:22 UTC, resolved=18:38 UTC.

elliot: I'll be secondary until 02:00 UTC. I'll monitor autoscaler logs and host evictions. If we see >3 repeat pages for the same symptom, escalate to oliver.

maya: Handover checklist / quick commands to run: ```kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=kvcache -o wide```  ```kubectl -n infra logs -f deployment/cache-regen```  Check dashboard: https://dash.ops/boards/kv-cache-eu-west  Also verify cache hit rate > 85% (metric: `kvcache.hit_rate`).

oliver (sre-lead): Added runbook pointer and perf artifacts to the support ticket. Perf snapshot uploaded: s3://redwood-ops/incidents/1809999999/perf-snapshot.tar.gz. I also updated the canary routing policy to prefer safe-fallback for eu-west for the next 3 hours.

maya: Next steps for the on-call team: 1) monitor p95 and hit-rate for 2 hours, 2) if cache hit rate drops <80% re-run regen with `--force`, 3) support to confirm ticket triage and customer comms (support assigned: amanda).

elliot: ack — I'll keep watch and post if I see anything anomalous.

maya: handing over now. Leaving CLI snippets + links in the ticket. Thanks all, glhf :thumbsup:

elliot: ack. enjoy your evening!
